priorities.summary: Improper authentication in Progress WS_FTP Server versions prior to 2024.0.6 and 2025.0.3 on Windows could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to access sensitive information, including administrative credentials. Upgrade to a fixed WS_FTP Server release.

An OS command injection vulnerability in Progress WS_FTP Server versions prior to 2024.0.7 and 2025.0.4 on Windows could allow arbitrary command execution under certain configurations. Upgrade to WS_FTP Server 2024.0.7 or 2025.0.4.

A use-after-free in the Linux kernel's IPv4 TCP handshake code could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to trigger memory corruption; the kernel CNA rates it 9.8. An upstream fix exists, but as of October 29 Ubuntu and RHEL had not yet shipped fixed kernels, so track distro advisories and patch when available.

model.name: Mistral Large 4 open weights (Le Chonk)
model.summary: Mistral released the open weights of its improved 1-trillion-parameter flagship on October 29, three weeks after its October 6 preview. The natively multimodal mixture-of-experts model (52 billion active parameters, 1-million-token context) leads open-weight coding benchmarks including FrontierCode 2.0 (19.7%) and can now be self-hosted under the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight Licence.
